description: Use this when you want a live chord sheet with -1 and +1 semitone controls. Accepts 1 to 12,000 characters in chord-line or ChordPro format; controls call transpose_chords. Shows the original key and chord counts plus a monospaced PDF. Chord names only; does not process audio, tablature or staff notation. Key estimates can be wrong for songs that change key.

from_key.description: Origin key; for example C or Am. Required with to_key; otherwise the header or first and last chords give a key estimate.

sheet.description: Chord sheet of 1 to 12,000 characters, with chords above lyrics or inline; for example C    G\nLanterns glow, or [Am]Lantern [F]garden.

spelling.description: Chord spelling; for example auto follows the target key, while sharps forces F# instead of Gb for consistent round trips.

title.description: PDF title up to 80 characters; for example Lantern Garden.

name: show_chord_sheet
title: Show chord sheet
